facts.text: I use Messenger mostly for chatting with friends and family.
Using Slack helps keep my work communication separate from my personal chats.
Using different platforms for personal and professional communication helps me mentally separate work from my personal life.
Separating my personal and work communication is super important for avoiding burnout.
I have noticed a difference in my mood and overall happiness since I started separating my personal and work communication.
I feel better when I'm using the right phone for the right situation.
I learned the importance of finding balance between work and personal life the hard way.
Finding that balance is a work in progress for me.
I use tools like Slack and Messenger to keep things organized and separate.
